question: Is this ticket, as written, a real end-to-end slice: one thin change carried through every layer it needs to something a user can run or see, with a demo that exercises that change (slice), rather than work confined to one layer, a deferred user-facing part, or a demo that is unrelated or only the gate going green (layer-only)?

label_help.slice: delivers a user-runnable or user-visible change (command, recipe, gate behaviour, CI run, agent behaviour) and its demo exercises that change; a stated Expand-contract step also counts. Agent behaviour counts: a role or prompt change whose demo runs the agent (e.g. scripts/pi-role on a fixture) and shows the changed behaviour is a slice.
label_help.layer-only: stops at one layer (schema, storage, adapter, contract or doc text), defers the user-facing part, or demos only an unrelated command or the gate staying green.

state_shape: The ticket body as filed or drafted, no title (What to build, Acceptance criteria, Blocked by). No review, qc or owner verdict.
